description:
What if Unity Hub and GitHub Desktop had a Baby but its Adopted? Yeah..


What's new in v1.3.5 - The Git Update
🚀 New
- Git Authentication: sign in to GitHub or GitLab with OAuth device flow - a code appears, you authorize it in your browser, and GodotHub uses your account for HTTPS push, pull, fetch and clone
- Self-hosted GitLab support: connect to your own instance by entering its base URL and an OAuth Application ID
- Personal access tokens for hosts that don't support OAuth sign-in, like Codeberg, Gitea and Bitbucket
- Create a repository on your connected GitHub or GitLab account right from the project creation flow, then push the initial commit
- New UI - Project time tracking: project cards now show how long you've spent in a project today and this week, with export/import of your stats
- Godot Archive as an alternative download source for Godot versions, with a quick switch when a release is missing from GitHub
- PR by jokka39: Add Russian translation
- PR by Spy-B: Start adding the Arabic translation
🐛 Fixes
- Portable .exe installs now show a clear 'manual update required' screen with a link to the latest GitHub release instead of failing silently
- Fixed several edge cases in the Git authentication flow
✨ Improvements
- New UI: Settings view refactored to be more UX friendly
- New UI: project cards revamp plus a new non-card layout
- New UI: revamped titlebar with language menu, running projects chip and task tray
- Language switcher moved into the titlebar
- Major performance and code-quality refactor across the Rust backend
- README: star history and supported languages sections, plus a new Contributing.md
